security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: asset: http://asset.localhost; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost https: http:; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Offline-capable word processor, spreadsheet, and presentation editor
bundle.longDescription: Simple Office Suite is a Tauri 2 desktop app with a word processor, spreadsheet editor with a formula engine, presentation editor, PDF viewer, and local demo Mail and Communicator modules. Documents open and save as SOS, Markdown, HTML, RTF, CSV, and PDF sources; Microsoft Office formats are not supported yet. Cloud AI is optional and only contacted when you configure a provider.
